entries.note: The sender asked for a pickup; the first scan of every sample.
The pickup waits for the sender to book a day; seen between the pickup request and its booking.
Sent on from a base to the next one.

entries.wording: AGUARDANDO CHEGADA DA CARGA PARA TRANSFERÊNCIA
entries.note: Repeated daily at the hub while the parcel waits for its onward load.

entries.wording: EM TRANSITO PARA O DESTINO FINAL
AGUARDANDO CHEGADA DA CARGA PARA ENTREGA
entries.note: At the delivering base, before a delivery round.

entries.wording: ENTREGA AGENDADA PARA PRÓXIMO DIA ÚTIL
entries.note: Delivery booked for the next working day; the parcel stays at the base.
Nobody was home on the delivery round; the sample's complaint describes these attempts.

entries.wording: ENCOMENDA RETIDA NA BASE, AGUARDANDO INFORMAÇÕES.
entries.note: Held at the base after a failed delivery until the recipient or sender answers.
The page shows who signed for it above the scans; the adapter leaves the name out.
